text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp to hone our skills
has arrived once again. As for how Verxina is doing—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-cchi, prepare yourself! ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I got it wrong!
And I was so confident, too~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Before we train,
I wanna play for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I mean, last year
you were super serious about it, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: We came all the way to the beach! So just for a little bit! Pretty please?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'll work super hard afterward! Pleeease? ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yay♡
That's my Trainy for ya!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone!
We got permission!"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-san!
Now then, shall we play~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction of the voice, I saw Vivlos's parents and her two older sisters together with her.
They were all dressed for a day at the beach...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
There's a swimsuit for you too, Trainie!
Big sis and I picked it out together~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Guess what, guess what!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Marine-colored board shorts!
They're stylish enough to wear around town, too♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I went with a frilly, nautical-style bikini♪
The sailor collar is just so super cute!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"It'll de-finitely suit you.
Great choice, right~?"
choice_data_list: I-Isn't that a little too cute!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos just wouldn't take no
for an answer."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're basically family already,
Trainie~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Right, Cheval-chi♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Doesn't something feel off after all?
It just feels so lifeless.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even though we're rivals who will clash
in the Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
!
Rivals...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Wipe that smirk off your face.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No way♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm glad.
I mean, the atmosphere between the two of them...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —It's just like being back in the old days.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the fun pre-training moments flew by in a flash—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I look forward to working with you once again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos was full of energy and motivation.
She's in great shape heading into the upcoming Japan Cup...
but we still can't afford to let our guard down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rather than concerns about her physical condition, it was more like—
choice_data_list: Fierce rivals will be competing in the "Japan Cup".

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It's Cheva-chi, right!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I'm with you,
I just can't help feeling happy, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You've gotten really strong right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand has shown remarkable growth lately.
Seeing her little sister's success has lit a burning fire of determination in her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand, having set her sights solely
on the "Japan Cup" and stayed focused on it.
She will likely prove to be a tremendous rival.
choice_data_list: Besides, Satono Crown is here too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Satono Crown, whom I also faced in the Takarazuka Kinen.
Capable of cleverly analyzing her defeats, she's likely even stronger now than she was back then."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Crown too, huh!
She's definitely a formidable opponent.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And!?
No, wait, who else is left...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, it couldn't be...
Kitasan... could it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehh~?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Kitasan's
the strongest Umamusume right now, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black—an Umamusume from an older generation than Vivlos. After winning the Kikuka Sho, she blossomed even further upon entering the Senior division.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With multiple consecutive GⅠ victories under her belt,
it's no exaggeration to call her the strongest Umamusume of our era."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, I see.
Cheval-chi, Crown, Kitasan...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's super awesome!
Can't wait♪
choice_data_list: You're really looking forward to it, aren't you?
You're really looking forward to it, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I mean, everyone's super strong, right?
So that makes them celebs, basically.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"If I beat all of them,
that makes me the number one celebrity!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then!
Don't you think I can become someone who can win in Dubai too?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
See, easy-peasy, right? ♡
Let's give it our all at summer training camp!
